annotations.title: UK company status for many companies

description: Free, no API key. Returns the company_status answer for 1 to 25 UK companies in one call. Each number counts as one call against the free hourly limit. Returns JSON with one field, results: an array in the order of the input, where each item is the company_status object, or an object with companyNumber and error for an invalid number. Company-level facts only. Indicators only, not advice.

company_numbers.description: UK Companies House registration numbers. 1 to 25 items.

fields.description: Optional. Field names to keep in each result, for example ["companyNumber","status"]. Unknown names are ignored. companyNumber, found and notice are always kept when present.

name: company_status_batch

found.description: False when no record exists for the company number.
